question: Under what conditions does Lakṣmī become pleased with the worshipper?
premises: The time specified is the full-moon day.
The sun is in Libra at that time.
Lakṣmī becomes pleased with that person.
inference: Lakṣmī’s favor is promised when worship occurs on a full-moon day with the sun in Libra.
plain_english: On the full-moon day, when the sun is in Libra, Lakṣmī is pleased with him.
